temporary_object_ledger.persistent_package_hash_unsupported_reas: no UE Python api exposes a content hash or save-state digest of a persistent package: UPackage.is_dirty(), UPackage.get_file_size() and the package GUID are not reflected to Python, and the only package-level state Python can read is MEMBERSHIP of the editor's dirty-package sets (unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.get_dirty_map_packages / get_dirty_content_packages), which is a boolean per package and not a digest. Hashing the .umap on disk would answer a different question — whether the file changed — and would still be blind to an in-memory mutation that was never saved, which is the mutation a survey is most likely to cause. P_1 == P_0 is therefore reported as UNSUPPORTED with value None; the observable identity half is reported separately as persistent_package_identity_equal.
temporary_object_ledger.spawn_policy: transient-only; this pass spawns nothing (marker clearance is trace-probed, never placed)

capsule_clear.derivation: capsule_clear = NOT overlap; None when overlap is None — an unmeasured capsule is not a clear one

footprint.derivation: footprint = all(trace(r).hit for r in footprint_trace_refs) AND grounded; None when any corner trace or the ground trace did not answer

grounded.derivation: grounded = trace(ground_trace_ref).hit; None when that trace did not answer — never coerced to False

overlap.derivation: overlap = len(capsule_overlap_actor_paths) > 0, over the union of the WorldStatic and WorldDynamic queries; None when either sub-query was unread

required_footprint_area_cm2.derivation: required_footprint_area_cm2 = pi * capsule_radius^2 — the capsule's full cross-section, i.e. the area the predicate's denominator refers to

supported_footprint_area_cm2.derivation: supported_footprint_area_cm2 = required_footprint_area_cm2 * (footprint_supported_sample_count / footprint_sample_count) — a 4-sample estimate on the offsets in footprint_sample_offsets_cm, not an integrated area

grounding_thresholds.note: grounding thresholds are policy, not observations; the far side was supplied none and invents none. The deriving side supplies them.
